**[P2] Ensure every drain covers records pending when it starts**

If an earlier drain has queued a flush, another execution queues a newer record, and a recordless drain starts, that last drain shares the older barrier. The in-flight check likewise considers only completed exports. It can therefore return before a record pending at its entry is exported and flushed, violating the documented drain guarantee and leaving buffering exporters holding records afterward. Snapshot the global schedule sequence at each drain's entry and share only a flush covering that snapshot. Queue a subsequent barrier when necessary without continually extending an earlier waiter's barrier, and test both queued and in-flight flush ordering.
